dependencies:
  # renovate: datasource=conda depName=bioconda/bwa-mem3
  - bioconda::bwa-mem3=0.18.0
  # renovate: datasource=conda depName=bioconda/fgumi

process FGUMI_RUNALL {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_high'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/f5/f5c9ad9982b305e1991119fa62a4cb3e51f85cc25d37535da335867d4df01670/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/bwa-mem3_fgumi_coreutils_findutils:586e53443c420260'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(reads), val(library)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta), path(fai), path(dict)
    tuple val(meta3), path(index)
    val start_from
    val stop_after

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.bam"), emit: bam
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('fgumi'), eval('fgumi --version | sed "s/^fgumi //"'), topic: versions, emit: versions_fgumi
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('bwamem3'), eval("bwa-mem3 version | sed -nE '1 s/^([0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)+).*/\\1/p'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_bwamem3

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def input = start_from == 'extract'
        ? "--extract::inputs ${reads} --extract::sample ${meta.id} --extract::library ${library}"
        : "--input ${reads}"
    if ("${reads}" == "${prefix}.bam") {
        error("Input and output names are the same, use \"task.ext.prefix\" to disambiguate!")
    }
    // The aligner reads its index from the `--ref` path, so the FASTA and the index must share one prefix
    def link_reference = index
        ? """
        # The index is a directory or a list of files: search the work directory, as bwamem3/mem does
        INDEX=`find -L ./ -name "*.amb" ! -name "*.meth.amb" | sed 's/\\.amb\$//'`
        REF=reference/`basename \$INDEX`
        mkdir reference
        for file in \$INDEX.*; do ln -s `realpath \$file` reference/; done
        ln -sf `realpath ${fasta}` \$REF
        ln -sf `realpath ${fai}` \$REF.fai
        ln -sf `realpath ${dict}` \$REF.dict
        """.stripIndent()
        : "REF=${fasta}"
    def reference = fasta ? "--ref \$REF" : ''
    """
    ${link_reference}

    fgumi runall \\
        --start-from ${start_from} \\
        --stop-after ${stop_after} \\
        ${input} \\
        ${reference} \\
        --output ${prefix}.bam \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        ${args}
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.bam
    """
}

name: "nf-core/fgumi/runall"
description: "Run several fgumi stages (extract, correct, align, zipper, sort, group,\
  \ consensus, filter) as one streaming process, with no intermediate BAM"
keywords:
- "UMIs"
- "alignment"
- "consensus"
- "bam"
- "fastq"
tools:
- fgumi:
    description: "High-performance tools for UMI-tagged sequencing data."
    homepage: "https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgumi"
    documentation: "https://fgumi.readthedocs.io/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/fgumi"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:fgumi"
- bwamem3:
    description: "Short-read aligner derived from bwa-mem2 with correctness fixes,\
      \ performance improvements, and methylation-aware alignment."
    homepage: "https://github.com/fg-labs/bwa-mem3"
    documentation: "https://github.com/fg-labs/bwa-mem3"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/fg-labs/bwa-mem3"
    licence:
    - "MIT AND Apache-2.0"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
        \ single_end:false ]`\n"
  - reads:
      type: "file"
      description: "FASTQ files with `start_from` set to `extract`, otherwise one\
        \ BAM\nin the state that `start_from` names\n"
      pattern: "*.{fastq.gz,fq.gz,bam}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1930"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - library:
      type: "string"
      description: "Library name for the read group. Only used with `start_from` set\
        \ to `extract`"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference genome FASTA file. Needed when the run aligns, or with\
        \ a methylation mode"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fna}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/data_2044"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - fai:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference genome FASTA index (.fai)"
      pattern: "*.fai"
      ontologies: []
  - dict:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference sequence dictionary (.dict)"
      pattern: "*.dict"
      ontologies: []
- - meta3:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing index information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome' ]`\n"
  - index:
      type: "directory"
      description: "bwa-mem3 index, as a directory or a list of files. Needed when\
        \ the run\naligns. It is linked next to the FASTA, so that `{ref}` in\n`--aligner::command`\
        \ finds both\n"
      pattern: "*"
      ontologies: []
- start_from:
    type: "string"
    description: "First stage to run"
    enum:
    - "extract"
    - "correct"
    - "align"
    - "sort"
    - "group"
    - "consensus"
    - "filter"
- stop_after:
    type: "string"
    description: "Last stage to run"
    enum:
    - "extract"
    - "correct"
    - "zipper"
    - "sort"
    - "group"
    - "consensus"
    - "filter"
output:
  bam:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.bam:
        type: "file"
        description: "Output BAM of the last stage"
        pattern: "*.bam"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  versions_fgumi:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - fgumi:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - fgumi --version | sed "s/^fgumi //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  versions_bwamem3:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - bwamem3:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - bwa-mem3 version | sed -nE '1 s/^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+).*/\1/p':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - fgumi:
        type: "string"
